appName: IDEMI Animation Dept — Task & Repository Database
author: Nilesh Sharma

milestones.name: Ingestion & Base Web App
milestones.summary: Built standalone task management app based on shared Gemini conversation and master spreadsheet (21 active, 102 completed, 34 repos).

milestones.name: GitHub Pages Deployment
milestones.summary: Created remote GitHub repository and deployed to GitHub Pages with live domain.

milestones.name: Zero Horizontal Scroll Fit
milestones.summary: Fit all 14 columns into screen width without horizontal scrollbars, sticky actions column, and view mode toggle.

milestones.name: Select All & Bulk Delete
milestones.summary: Added row checkboxes, select all toggle, selection count bar, and batch deletion.

milestones.name: Google Cloud Firestore Migration
milestones.summary: Migrated database to dedicated Google Cloud Firestore (idemi-task-management-db in asia-south1) with sub-second real-time sync.

milestones.name: Mobile Responsiveness (OnePlus 10R 5G)
milestones.summary: Designed mobile touch cards view, 2x3 KPI grid, touch-swipe Kanban, and bottom-sheet modals for 412x919 px viewport.

milestones.name: Admin Panel & Access Control
milestones.summary: Implemented Read-Only mode for viewers, Master Edit Lock, SHA-256 passcode authentication, audit log, and dedicated Admin Control Panel.

milestones.name: Cloud Communication Update to idemi-work
milestones.summary: Uploaded complete communication history to Google Cloud Storage (gs://idemi-work-docs/), Cloud Logging, Firestore, and GitHub repository.
